summary: A background job keeps its place: the worker records what is done, in hand and next, so a long job no longer loses its thread, and Nora can see it while the job runs.
details: The worker saves a short checkpoint (done, doing, next, decisions) at each step, and its history is now a sliding window that is re-anchored on that checkpoint and on what code recorded as made.
Nora's sub-agent block shows a running job's doing and next, and reading a job shows the whole checkpoint; what was made always comes from code, never from the worker's own list.
A job that stops early is delivered with where it had got to, and a finished job's report now ends with Done, Not done and Decisions.
limitations: A job that is running when this ships has no checkpoint and carries on as before.
A restart still ends a running job as lost; the checkpoint is not used to resume it.
